name: mmoa_admin_console
description: Operator-only admin console for the Mission Men of Anna web app (mmoa_web_app). Connects to the web app's database and host to manage events, raffles, nonprofit verification, the board, data, website content, uploads, configuration, logs, and backups.

scripts.prestart: npm run build:css && npm run copy:alpine

_dependencies_info.@aws-sdk/client-ssm: AWS Systems Manager SDK v3. Used by helpers/awsSsm.js for the 'Remote on EC2 (AWS)' Web App access mode — every command / file read / file write on the web app instance runs as an SSM Run Command (SendCommand + GetCommandInvocation polling). Lazy-required so the app still boots without it. This console never creates or modifies AWS resources.
_dependencies_info.alpinejs: Tiny client-side reactivity framework — drives form-field show/hide, live previews, and confirm dialogs via inline x-data directives. Self-hosted at /js/alpine.min.js to satisfy CSP.
_dependencies_info.bcrypt: Password hashing for console admin login and for nonprofit passwords set from the Nonprofits page (cost 10, same as the web app).
_dependencies_info.cookie-session: Signed-cookie sessions for admin login state.
_dependencies_info.express-rate-limit: Per-IP throttling on the login endpoint.
_dependencies_info.multer: Multipart form-data parser used for background image uploads (Settings → Appearance), website image uploads, event / raffle / board / nonprofit image uploads (memory storage, 8 MB), and backup file uploads.
_dependencies_info.sqlite3: SQLite driver (local development / local-mode web app).
_dependencies_info.ssh2: SSH/SFTP client used by helpers/webAppAccess.js for the 'Remote via SSH' Web App access mode (run commands, read/write files). Lazy-required so the app still boots without it.
_dependencies_info.@tailwindcss/cli: (devDep) Standalone CLI used to compile tailwind.input.css → public/css/tailwind.css.
_dependencies_info.tailwindcss: (devDep) Utility-first CSS framework. Built once at start time via the `build:css` script.
